data.name: Hafeel
data.long_meaning: Hafeel is derived from the Arabic root 'hafala' which means 'to protect, to guard'. It is a name of honor for someone who takes responsibility for the protection and care of others. In Islamic history, Hafeel is the name of a companion of Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) who was known for his bravery and his unwavering commitment to the protection of the Muslim community.

data.cultural_impact: The name Hafeel carries a significant cultural impact as it reflects the value of companionship, protection, and community care that is deeply rooted in Islamic teachings and traditions. Hafeel is a name for someone who is valued for his commitment and capability to protect and safeguard others. In some communities, it is customary to give this name to a child as a reminder of his responsibility towards his family, community, and faith.
data.spiritual_significance: From a spiritual perspective, the name Hafeel carries a deep meaning as it reflects the role of caretaker and protector that every believer is called to play in the Islamic community. The Prophet Muhammad (pbuh) said that "Paradise lies at the feet of the mother," emphasizing the importance of care and protection for the most vulnerable members of society. Furthermore, the Quran encourages believers to "Take, [O Muhammad], from their [the orphans’] [guardianship of their] properties no más nor less than [provision] and [otherwise] bring them up with the Qur'an and give them the good in food and clothing and do not [stint] with regard to their behavior" (2:223). By giving the name Hafeel, parents and community members affirm the spiritual significance of this role and offer a prayerful reminder of the responsibility that is entailed in it.
